resources.title: Model Card Template (Code-Fillable)
resources.description: The model-card template from Lesson 24's documentation workflow, generalized for any project in this course: a Purpose/Data/Method/Results/Limitations/Environment skeleton with {placeholder} fields meant to be filled by str.format from real code output, not typed by hand. Includes the worked, filled-in version from the Cascade Beverage demand-model worked example as a concrete model.

resources.title: Metric and Threshold Decision Guide
resources.description: A one-page compiled reference for picking a classification metric and a decision threshold without second-guessing: when to trust accuracy versus average precision versus ROC AUC, how the accuracy trap shows up in a dummy baseline, and the three-step recipe (cross_val_predict -> sweep thresholds by cost -> confirm once on the test set) used throughout Chapters 2 and 4.

resources.title: Equipment Sensor Sample Dataset (Illustrative)
resources.description: A 1,000-row sample of a seeded, illustrative machine-week sensor table built with the same relationship used in the Meridian Manufacturing predictive-maintenance worked example (vibration, bearing temperature, run hours since preventive maintenance, cycle count, press class, plant, and the failure label). About 4% of rows are failures, a realistic rare-event imbalance for practicing the Chapter 4 workflow without waiting to generate your own data.
